title: Integral orientation source and exceptional unit have shifted sheaf tower models
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ embedded in an algebraic closure, and an algebraically closed field $k$ of characteristic $p\ne\ell$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and let $f=\bar f\circ j:X\to Y$ be smooth of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$, with $j$ open and $\bar f$ proper [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Fix the actual strict coefficient tower categories [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], simultaneous reduction, normalized equivalences and a realized integral/tower adjunction package R [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection]. Write $r_X,r_Y$ for its simultaneous reductions and $G$ for its tower right adjoint. Let $T\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\mathcal O_E)$ and $U\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ be representatives with specified isomorphisms $T\simeq\mathbf1_X(d)[2d]$ and $U\simeq\mathbf1_Y$, using the completed coefficients and integral Tate line [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Then there exist objects $L,W$ of the abelian category of strict coefficient tower sheaves on X with isomorphisms $r_X(T)\simeq L[0][2d]$ and $G(r_Y(U))\simeq W[0][2d]$ in its ordinary derived category. Here $L[0]$ and $W[0]$ mean the degree-zero single embeddings [lem-weil-pbc-derived-single-fully-faithful]. There is no statement about maps or injectivity.

source.place: Clause (1), shifted rank-one tower sheaves; source comparison from integral-adjunction-bijection Purity paragraph

proof.text: Apply the entire-system comparison of [lem-sp-twisted-pullback-reduction-tower] to the integral coefficient unit, twist d and shift 2d. Pullback of the coefficient unit is the unit; use the tensor unitor and the given identification of T with the shifted integral Tate line. Signed-line scalar/tensor comparison identifies the ordered tensor presentation with the single Tate sheaf tower. The comparison retains every quotient transition, so this yields a sheaf tower L and an isomorphism r_X(T) ≅ L[2d].

The diagonal entire-tower orientation of [det-sp-tower-gamma](1) identifies the shifted Tate sheaf tower with the exceptional tower image of the coefficient tower. Apply reduction to the given identification of U with the integral coefficient unit. The unit reduction comparison identifies r_Y(U) with that coefficient tower. Functoriality of G transports this identification to G(r_Y(U)), giving its shifted sheaf presentation (take W=L). No map between T and this target enters either construction.

theorem shifted_sheaf_models
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (_iE : E →ₐ[Padic l] Ω)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [(j ≫ p).IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (j ≫ p)]
    (T : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X)
    (U : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y)
    (_hT : T.obj ≅ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (integralTwistLine l E X (d : ℤ)))⟦2 * (d : ℤ)⟧)
    (_hU : U.obj ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E Y))) :
    ∃ L W : spCoefficientTowers l E X,
      Nonempty
        (((SpIntegralAdjunction.reduce l E X (q.abelian X) RX R.reductionX).obj T).obj ≅
          ((@DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ _ _ (q.abelian X).hasDerived 0).obj
            L)⟦2 * (d : ℤ)⟧) ∧
      Nonempty
        ((G.obj ((SpIntegralAdjunction.reduce l E Y (q.abelian Y) RY
          R.reductionY).obj U)).obj ≅
          ((@DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ _ _ (q.abelian X).hasDerived 0).obj
            W)⟦2 * (d : ℤ)⟧)
